item.title: I built a job grading tool so I stop guessing what roles are worth
item.description: I got tired of hiring managers arguing about whether a Senior Engineer should be a ‘5’ or a ‘6’. So I built a tool that uses Google’s Point-Factor Method to grade roles objectively. Here is how it works, what I learned, and why I think this matters.
